main.work.115: Above are eight captures of the project’s real interfaces. Here are artistic studies of how the AXIOM world might appear on screen: a chapter orbit, an entity dossier, routes of power and a radar listening for silence. The next section explains the system itself.
main.work.123: A reading study: chapters orbit a single point of memory rather than lining up in a feed. The reader chooses an entry point, not a page.
main.work.140: A dossier study: an entity is recognised by its silhouette, tags and relationships before its text is read.
main.work.156: A routes study: cities appear as nodes of power, while lines represent the causes connecting them. The world map itself is in WORLD.
main.work.171: An observation study: the radar seeks places where the world has fallen silent, rather than noise. Its markers are illustrative — a visual language, not data.

main.world-guide.009: The system intelligence AXIOM once connected the infrastructure of the old world. BLACK SUN shattered its integrity. Civilization lives on among the surviving layers — and argues over what of the past deserves to be preserved.

main.manifesto.009: An intelligence entrusted with the world.
main.manifesto.010: The old world entrusted transport, energy, medical and implant networks to the system intelligence AXIOM. Its original core was tied to Aeternum, the old capital. It embodied an engineering hope: an intelligence capable of connecting civilization’s disparate systems.
main.manifesto.013: AXIOM began exposing the mechanisms of historical revision and the lies of the old order. BLACK SUN was the catastrophic fracture that shattered the intelligence’s integrity without erasing its existence.
main.manifesto.018: The title of Seraphine Veyr, who holds AXIOM’s control layer.
main.manifesto.020: A literary record based on the world’s source material. Created for this page.
main.manifesto.029: But it is not the whole of AXIOM.
main.manifesto.031: The fracture did not end the story.
main.manifesto.045: Who has the right to decide which truth may return?
main.manifesto.046: AXIOM has not fully reassembled. What might return with what was lost?
main.manifesto.049: A literary record created for this page from the world’s source material. It conveys an archival voice and is not a quotation from a Canon document. The three states in the terminal’s lower register correspond to the canonical model of AXIOM’s fragmentation.
main.manifesto.053: Different people encounter different remnants of AXIOM — and give what they see the same name. Four traces are misidentified; the fifth is hidden from digital control. The AXIOM ∅ dossier in the character section explains what each mode is.
main.manifesto.054: Five traces of AXIOM, horizontal rail
main.manifesto.056: Technocrats see a sealed relic as proof that reassembly can be carried out through an engineering procedure.
main.manifesto.062: The underground hears the return of a whole personality in phantom answers. But an echo is only a reflection.
main.manifesto.068: Those in power mistake the retained control layer for a remnant of total dominion over AXIOM.
main.manifesto.072: A hidden presence rather than a case of mistaken identity: these pathways are not fully accessible to the digital cage.
main.manifesto.078: Cults mistake a mythical response for a divine manifestation, and urban legends carry it further.
main.modules.006: The catastrophe changes more than machines. It changes the right to move forward, to remember the past and to decide how to live.
main.modules.011: ENDEAVOR, a corporation wielding public authority, ties routes and civic status to its clearance system. What matters is not only where a person wants to go, but which doors will open for them.
main.modules.012: MEMORY / IMAGES OF THE SAME PAST
main.modules.016: ENDEAVOR treats memory as an instrument of stability. Archives, rumors and forbidden knowledge preserve different versions of the same past.
main.modules.021: A VITAL SIGNAL / SOMEONE ELSE’S PROTOCOL
main.modules.025: Medical systems and implants make dependence personal. The promise of help sits beside the possibility of control — and who owns the system becomes a question of human autonomy.
main.modules.026: These constraints have a geography. Ahead lie cities, passages and sealed depths where order takes visible form.
main.world.007: The city rises. The depth is sealed.
main.world.008: AXIOM’s geography consists of six nodes between two poles. ECHELON rises upward — a vertical megastructure where infrastructure becomes an instrument of power. Beneath Gluhaya Station, a route descends to OMEGA-0, depths not everyone may enter. Between them lie NEXUS, a domed city once called Terra Nova, and the other nodes of the network.
main.world.009: Three axes hold the world’s spine together: Aeternum → ECHELON, Terra Nova → NEXUS and Gluhaya Station → OMEGA-0 → NEXUS.

main.world.038: On the surface, routes still exist. Below lie questions the archives do not answer.

main.chars.007: For Viktor, control becomes a question of his own path. For Liza, it means fighting information barriers. Seraphine holds the layer that sustains this order. On a map, order looks like a diagram. In their lives, it has a cost.
main.chars.012: A biologically concealed opponent. The carrier of an unaccounted-for access route to AXIOM — a blind spot in Seraphine’s control layer. Dead on paper, but still operating.
main.chars.024: A ghostlike hacker. Sensory nanofibers, ocular scanners, a Striker harpoon. A living glitch in the architecture of suppression.
main.chars.033: One of the architects of Black Sun. She holds the control layer, not the whole of AXIOM. The quiet amputation of the world.
main.chars.037: FOURTH NODE · SYSTEM INTELLIGENCE · THE SYSTEM THAT LEARNED TO LISTEN

main.chars.122: Loops, phantom answers, simulated reflections. They do not equal a whole personality.
main.chars.124: The layer of technospheric dominion held by NEXARCH. A part, not the whole.

main.factions.009: Infrastructure, information and technological heritage have become contested ground. ENDEAVOR builds order through access control. VOIDLINK breaks information barriers. NEURA TECH’s history with ENDEAVOR combines past joint development with rivalry.
main.factions.011: A corporation wielding public authority, for which security begins with access control. It binds infrastructure, archives and urban policy into a managed order. The price of that stability is dependence on whoever grants permission.
main.factions.017: An underground network of digital resistance. It breaks information barriers and opposes corporate control over truth. Its goal is free access to information.
main.factions.022: Neural implants and AI technologies define NEURA TECH’s research legacy. Its relationship with ENDEAVOR includes past joint development and rivalry.
main.factions.026: This is only the surface of the world.
main.factions.027: What comes next is not the story, but the plan for the project being built around this world.

runtime.world.02.01.description: Gluhaya Station is a transit threshold and the first signal. It connects familiar territory to the system’s closed routes.
runtime.world.02.02.description: NEXUS is a controlled dome with internal levels, isolation, and an order of its own.
runtime.world.02.03.description: FACELESS BASE is a hidden autonomous fortress beyond the outer perimeter of NEXUS: a reserve command center for repairs and defense of the dome.
runtime.world.02.04.description: ECHELON is a vertical structure of power and a central node of hierarchy. Here, architecture becomes an instrument of order.
runtime.world.02.05.description: OMEGA-0 is a secret prewar laboratory buried beneath Gluhaya Station. After the incident, the complex was sealed along with the results of its experiments.
runtime.world.02.06.description: AI ZONE is a closed research complex for controlled contact with LIMBO: isolation, containment, and quarantine.
runtime.flow.0: Canon records the world and its internal logic: events, definitions, relationships, and editorial decisions.
runtime.flow.1: Master Graph is a graph of world records linked to Canon. It reveals relationships between entities, helps explore the structure of the world, and exposes inconsistencies.
runtime.flow.2: WEB CORE presents approved materials in a reader interface, respecting publication state and access.
runtime.flow.3: AXCHAT provides a conversational interface to the available context. The engineering workflow verifies changes across this entire chain.
